subject: general
question: Select the most suitable title for the given passage.

options.text: The Problem Of Controlling the Common Cold
The Technique of Tissue Culture Independently

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** The passage focuses on **the challenges and difficulties faced by medical science in controlling the common cold.**
 
• It** highlights** the complexity of the viruses involved, the technical difficulties in studying them, and the reasons why finding a solution has been elusive.
 
• This makes **"The Problem Of Controlling the Common Cold" the most** **suitable title** as it succinctly captures the main theme of the passage.
 
• **In summary, option 1 most accurately represents the central theme and focus of the passage, which is the ongoing struggle and complexities involved in controlling the common cold.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Most Frequent Infectious Diseases:** This title is too broad and does not specifically focus on the common cold, which is the main subject of the passage.
 
• **Viruses Gain Immunity from Colds:** This is factually incorrect based on the passage, as it is humans who generally do not gain immunity from colds.
 
• **The Technique of Tissue Culture Independently:** While tissue culture is mentioned, it is not the main focus of the passage. The passage primarily discusses the broader issue of controlling the common cold.
